title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 9 章‧九夜大淨禮（巴爾什農）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, ahura mazda
mainyô spênishta dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum kutha aêtadha anghava astvaiñti
mashyâka hãm- vaênåñte tê
ýôi hãm-nasûm paiti-iristem tanûm
ýaozhdaithyãn.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: O most beneficent Spirit,
Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! To whom shall they
apply here below, who want to cleanse their body defiled by the
dead?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：最仁慈的善靈啊，物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那些想要淨潔其身體被死亡污染的人，應當在此下界向誰求助呢？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, narem ashavanem spitama
zarathushtra ýô anghat vacô arsh- vacô
mãthrem peresô ashava ýô fraêshtem
apivatâite daênayå mâzdayasnôish
ýaozhdâthryât haca, hô perethwe ainghå
zemô upa-thwarshti urvaranãm nava vî-bâzva
drâjô kemcit paiti cathrushanãm
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'To a pious man, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
who knows how to speak, who speaks truth, who has learned the
Holy Word [manthra], who is pious, and knows best the rites of cleansing
according to the law of Mazda. That man shall fell the trees off
the surface of the ground on a space of nine Vibazus square;
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：向一位虔誠的人求助，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！他知曉如何言語，他言說真理，他已學習聖言，他虔誠，他最懂得按馬茲達的法律進行淨禮的儀式。那人應當在地面上清除樹木，清除面積為九維塔斯提見方的地方；

segments.orig:
ýat anghat ainghå zemô vî-âpô-
tememca vî-urvarô-tememca ... thrigâim haca
nerebyô ashavabyô.
segments.en:
'in that part of the ground where there is least water and
where there are fewest trees, the part which is the cleanest and
driest, and the least passed through by sheep and oxen, and by
the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the consecrated bundles of Baresma,
and by the faithful.'
How far from the fire? How far from the water? How far from
the consecrated bundles of Baresma? How far from the faithful?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty paces from the fire, thirty
paces from the water, thirty paces from the consecrated bundles
of Baresma, three paces from the faithful.
segments.zh: 該地方應當是水最少的地方，樹木最少的地方，最潔淨最乾燥的地方，綿羊和牲牛經過最少的地方，以及阿胡拉‧馬茲達的聖火、祝聖的巴雷斯瑪束、和信眾經過最少的地方。離聖火多遠？離水多遠？離祝聖的巴雷斯瑪束多遠？離信眾多遠？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：離聖火三十步，離水三十步，離祝聖的巴雷斯瑪束三十步，離信眾三步。

segments.orig:
paoirîm upa makhem nithweresôish pasca hamô
aiwi- gaitîm dva erezu nismahe pasca zemô isaosh aiwi-gaitîm
ýatha cathwârô erezvô.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt dig a hole, two fingers deep if the summer
has come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have come.
segments.zh: 然後你應當掘一個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。

segments.orig:
bitîm upa makhem ... thritîm upa makhem ... tûirîm
upa makhem ... puxdhem ... xshtûm....
segments.en:
'Thou shalt dig a second hole, two fingers deep if the summer
has come, four fingers deep if the winter end ice have come.
'Thou shalt dig a third hole, two fingers deep if the summer has
come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have come.
'Thou shalt dig a fourth hole, two fingers deep if the summer
has come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have come.
'Thou shalt dig a fifth hole, two fingers deep if the summer has
come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have come.
'Thou shalt dig a sixth hole, two fingers deep if the summer has
come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have come.'
segments.zh: 你應當掘第二個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。你應當掘第三個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。你應當掘第四個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。你應當掘第五個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。你應當掘第六個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。

segments.orig:
cvat haca anyô-anyaêibyô, ýatha aêvô-gâim,
katha aêvô-gâim, ýatha thripadhem.
segments.en:
How far from one another?
'One pace.'
How much is the pace?
'As much as three feet.
segments.zh: 相距多遠？一步。一步是多少？三尺。

segments.orig:
thrâyô anya makha nithweresôish pasca hamô
aiwi-gaitîm dva erezu nismahe pasca zemô isaosh aiwi-gaitîm
ýatha cathwârô erezvô, cvat haca paourvaêibya,
ýatha thrigâim, katha thrigâim, ýatha
gâmãn hañcayata, katha gâmãn
hañcayata, ýatha nava-padhem.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt dig three holes more, two fingers deep if
the summer has come, four fingers deep if the winter and ice have
come.'
How far from the former six?
'Three paces.'
What sort of paces?
'Such as are taken in walking.'
How much are those (three) paces?
'As much as nine feet.
segments.zh: 然後你應當再掘三個洞，如果夏季已至則掘兩指深，如果冬季和結冰已至則掘四指深。距離前六個洞多遠？三步。什麼樣的步子？走路時邁出的步子。那（三）步是多少？九尺。

segments.orig:
karshascit frakârayôish tikhra xshathra vairyô,
cvat haca makhaêibya, ýatha thrigâim, katha
thrigâim, ýatha gâmãn hañcayata,
katha gâmãn hañcayata, ýatha nava-padhem.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt draw a furrow all around with a metal knife.'
How far from the holes?
'Three paces.'
What sort of paces?
'Such as are taken in walking.'
How much are those (three) paces?
'As much as nine feet.
segments.zh: 然後你應當用金屬刀在周圍劃一條溝渠。距離這些洞多遠？三步。什麼樣的步子？走路時邁出的步子。那（三）步是多少？九尺。

segments.orig:
âat pasca dva-dasa karsha frakârayôish thrâyô
ýim añtare vîta añtare thrâyô
makha frakârayôish thrâyô ýim añtare
vîta añtare xshvash makha frakârayôish
thrâyô ýim añtare vîta añtare
nava makha frakârayôish thrâyô añtareca
avañtare pâreñtare makha frakârayôish
thrâyô upa nava-padhem asânô âiti
makha âiti barôish safem vâ dâdrum vâ
zem-varetem vâ kãmcit vâ xrûzhdismanãm.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt draw twelve furrows; three of which thou
shalt draw to surround and divided [from the rest] (the first)
three holes; three thou shalt draw to surround and divide (the
first) six holes; three thou shalt draw to surround and divide
the nine holes; three thou shalt draw around the [three] inferior
holes, outside the [six other] holes. At each of the three times
nine feet, thou shalt place stones as steps to the holes; or potsherds,
or stumps, or clods, or any hard matter.'
segments.zh: 「然後汝應劃十二條溝；其中三條汝應劃來環圍並分隔（第一個）三個洞；三條汝應劃來環圍並分隔（第一個）六個洞；三條汝應劃來環圍並分隔九個洞；三條汝應劃來環圍〔三個〕下層的洞，在〔六個其他〕洞之外。在三個九步之處的每一處，汝應在洞前放置石頭作為臺階；或陶片，或樹樁，或土塊，或任何堅硬物質。」

segments.orig:
pascaêta ava tâ âiti makha âiti jasôit
aêsha ýâ paiti-irista, âat tûm
zarathushtra ava-hishtôish ava nishtarem karshayå
atha imã vacô dreñjayôish, nemascâ
ýâ ârmaitish îzhâcâ, paiti-shê
âdhayôit aêsha ýâ paiti-irista,
nemascâ ýâ ârmaitish îzhâcâ.
segments.en:
'Then the man defiled shall walk to the holes; thou, O Zarathushtra!
shalt stand outside by the furrow, and thou shalt recite,
 Nemascha ya armaitish izhacha ; and the man defiled shall repeat,
 Nemascha ya armaitish izhacha.
segments.zh: 「然後不潔淨的人應走向洞；汝，查拉圖斯特拉啊！應站在溝外，汝應誦讀，『尼瑪施查雅‧阿爾邁提什‧伊茲哈查』；不潔淨的人應重複，『尼瑪施查雅‧阿爾邁提什‧伊茲哈查』。」

segments.orig:
âat hâ druxsh avâstryeite kãmcit
vâ vacanghãm snathâi angrahe manyêush
drvatô snathâi aêshmahe xrvîm-draosh snathâi
mâzainyanãm daêvanãm snathâi vîspanãm
daêvanãm.
segments.en:
'The Druj becomes weaker and weaker at every one of those
words which are a weapon to smite the fiend Angra Mainyu, to smite
Aeshma of the murderous spear, to smite the
Mazainya fiends, to smite all the fiends.
segments.zh: 「德魯格變得越來越虛弱，在這些言詞的每一個中——這些言詞是用來擊打惡魔安格拉‧曼紐的武器，用來擊打謀殺矛的埃什瑪的武器，用來擊打馬札尼亞魔鬼的武器，用來擊打所有魔鬼的武器。」

segments.orig:
gaomaêzem pascaêta upangherezem ayanghaênem
vâ srum vâ, ýezi srum paiti-hiñcâi
graom ayasôish zarathushtra nava-pixem âdreñjayôish
aom srum paurva-naêmât ahe gravahe.
segments.en:
'Then thou shalt take for the gomez a spoon of iron or of
lead. When thou takest a stick with nine knots,
O Spitama Zarathushtra! to sprinkle (the gomez) from that spoon,
thou shalt fasten the spoon to the end of the stick.
segments.zh: 「然後汝應為取戈麥茲而備一柄鐵製或鉛製的湯匙。當汝取一根有九個結的木棒時，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！用以從該湯匙灑灑〔戈麥茲〕，汝應將湯匙繫在木棒的末端。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'They shall wash his hands first. If his hands be not washed
first, he makes his whole body unclean. When he has washed his
hands three times, after his hands have been washed, thou shalt
sprinkle the forepart of his skull; then the Druj Nasu rushes
in front, between his brows.
segments.zh: 「他們應當先洗他的雙手。若他的雙手先未被洗淨，他使其整個身體不潔。當他洗過雙手三次後，雙手既已被洗淨，你應灑淨他頭顱的前部；此後德魯格‧納蘇衝向前，在他的眉間。」

hôyum hê zañgem paiti-hiñcôish
âat hâ druxsh ýâ nasush dashinem frabdem
upa-dvãsaiti, dashinem hê frabdem paiti-hiñcôish
âat hâ druxsh ýâ nasush hôyum frabdem
upa-dvãsaiti, hôyum hê frabdem paiti-hiñcôish
âat hâ druxsh ýâ nasush adhairi haxem
nivôiryete mãnayen ahe ýatha maxshyå
parenem.
segments.en:
'Thou shalt sprinkle the left ankle; then the Druj Nasu rushes
upon the right instep.
'Thou shalt sprinkle the right instep; then the Druj Nasu rushes
upon the left instep.
'Thou shalt sprinkle the left instep; then the Druj Nasu turns
round under the sole of the foot; it looks like the wing of a
fly.
segments.zh:
「汝應灑淨左踝；爾時德魯格‧納蘇撲向右足背。
「汝應灑淨右足背；爾時德魯格‧納蘇撲向左足背。
「汝應灑淨左足背；爾時德魯格‧納蘇在足底下迴轉；其狀如蠅之翅。

segments.orig:
hakat nigereptaêibya añgushtaêibya uzgereptaêibya

âat hâ druxsh ýâ nasush hôyum haxem

'He shall press his toes upon the ground and shall raise up
his heels; thou shalt sprinkle his right sole; then the Druj Nasu
rushes upon the left sole.
'Thou shalt sprinkle the left sole; then the Druj Nasu turns round
under the toes; it looks like the wing of a fly.
segments.zh:
「彼應以足趾著地而舉起足跟；汝應灑淨其右足底；爾時德魯格‧納蘇撲向左足底。
「汝應灑淨左足底；爾時德魯格‧納蘇在足趾下迴轉；其狀如蠅之翅。

segments.orig:

maxshi kehrpa erekhaitya frashnaosh apa-zadhanghô akaranem

segments.en:
'He shall press his heels upon the ground and shall raise
up his toes; thou shalt sprinkle his right toe; then the Druj
Nasu rushes upon the left toe.
'Thou shalt sprinkle the left toe; then the Druj Nasu flies away
to the regions of the north, in the shape of a raging fly, with
knees and tail sticking out, droning without end, and like unto
the foulest Khrafstras.
segments.zh:
「彼應以足跟著地而舉起足趾；汝應灑淨其右足趾；爾時德魯格‧納蘇撲向左足趾。
「汝應灑淨左足趾；爾時德魯格‧納蘇飛向北方之地，形若狂暴之蠅，膝與尾突露，嗡嗡無歇，如最污穢之克赫拉夫斯特拉獸。

segments.orig:
atha imã vacô dreñjayôish ýôi
anghen vârethrakhnyôtememca baêshazyôtememca,
ýathâ ahû vairyô athâ ratush ...
mâmereñcainîsh gaêthå astvaitîsh
ashahe.
segments.en:
'And thou shalt say these victorious, most healing words:
'" Yatha ahu vairyo: -
The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness.
'"The gifts of Vohu-mano to deeds done in this world for
Mazda.
'"He who relieves the poor makes Ahura king.
'" Kem-na mazda: - What protector hadst thou given unto me,
O Mazda! while the hate of the wicked encompasses me? Whom, but
thy Atar and Vohu-mano, through whose work I keep on the world
of Righteousness? Reveal therefore to me thy Religion as thy rule!
'"Ke verethrem-ja: - Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching? Make it clear that I am the guide for both worlds.
May Sraosha come with Vohu-mano and help whomsoever thou pleasest,
O Mazda!
'"Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta! Perish,
O fiendish Druj! Perish, O brood of the fiend! Perish, O world
of the fiend! Perish away, O Druj! Rush away, O Druj! Perish away,
O Druj! Perish away to the regions of the north, never more to
give unto death the living world of Righteousness"
segments.zh:
而你應說這些勝利的、最具療癒的言詞：
「雅塔‧阿胡‧瓦伊立：——
主的意志乃正義之法。
「沃胡‧瑪諾的贈禮乃為此世所行之事而獻予馬茲達。
「凡濟貧者使阿胡拉為王。
「凱姆納‧馬茲達：——當邪惡者的仇恨包圍我時，啊馬茲達！你曾給我何保護者？除卻你的阿塔爾與沃胡‧瑪諾外，誰能藉其功行使我守持正義之世？是故將你的宗教啟示予我，作為你的法則！
「凱‧瓦雷特睿姆賈：——誰是勝利者將保護你的教導？使之明白我乃雙世之導引。願斯勞沙與沃胡‧瑪諾同來，幫助凡你所悅納者，啊馬茲達！
「願我們得免於我等仇敵，啊馬茲達與斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提！滅亡吧，惡靈的德魯格！滅亡吧，惡靈的孳生者！滅亡吧，惡靈的世界！滅亡去吧，德魯格！逃遁去吧，德魯格！滅亡去吧，德魯格！滅亡去往北方之域，永不復將死亡贈予正義之生活的世界。」

segments.orig:
pascaêta ava tâ nishhidhôit aêsha
ýâ paiti-irista añtare aredhem makhahe pâreñtare
haca anyaêibyô makhaêibyô avavat tadha
ýatha cathwârô erezavô aêtaêshãmca
zemô perethu-fravâish fradhavata.
segments.en:
'Afterwards the man defiled shall sit down, inside the furrows,
outside the furrows of the six holes, four fingers from those
furrows. There he shall cleanse his body with thick handfuls of
dust.
segments.zh: 『其後被污穢者應坐下，在六個洞穴的田溝內側，在田溝外側四指之處。他應以厚實的塵土把握住淨潔其身體。

segments.orig:
pañca-dasa zemô hañkanayen vîspem
â ahmât upa-mãnayen ýat hê upemem
paiti vakhdhanahe upemât varsa hiku bavât.
segments.en:
'Fifteen times shall they take up dust from the ground for
him to rub his body, and they shall wait there until he is dry
even to the last hair on his head.
segments.zh: 『十五次他們應為他從地上取起塵土以擦拭其身體，他們應在那裡等待直到他乾燥甚至到他頭上最後一根毛髮。

segments.orig:
ýat hê tanush hishvi hikhnvi pãsnu bavât
pascaêta ava tâ anya makha âiti jasôit
aêsha ýâ paiti-irista, paoirîm upa makhem
hakeret âpô âat hvãm tanûm pairi-ýaozhdaithîta
bitîm upa makhem bizhvat âpô âat hvãm
tanûm pairi-ýaozhdaithîta thritîm upa
makhem thrizhvat âpô âat hvãm tanûm
pairi-ýaozhdaithîta.
segments.en:
'When his body is dry with dust, then he shall step over the
holes (containing water). At the first hole he shall wash his
body once with water; at the second hole he shall wash his body
twice with water; at the third hole he shall wash his body thrice
with water.
segments.zh: 『當其身體已為塵土乾燥時，其後他應跨越那些洞穴（含有水）。在第一個洞穴處他應以水洗淨其身體一次；在第二個洞穴處他應以水洗淨其身體二次；在第三個洞穴處他應以水洗淨其身體三次。

segments.orig:
pascaêta dim â-baodhayaêta urvâsnayå
vâ vohu-gaonahe vâ vohu-keretôish vâ hadhânaêpatayå
vâ kãmcit vâ hubaoidhitemanãm urvaranãm
vastrå pascaêta aiwyånghayaêta pascaêta
ava tâ âiti nmâna âiti jasôit aêsha
ýâ paiti-irista.
segments.en:
'Then he shall perfume (his body) with Urvasna, or Vohu-gaona,
or Vohu-kereti, or Hadha-naepata, or any other sweet-smelling
plant; then he shall put on his clothes, and shall go back to
his house.
segments.zh: 『其後他應以烏爾瓦斯那或沃胡‧蓋歐納或沃胡‧克雷提或哈達‧那埃帕塔或任何其他芬芳的植物薰香（其身體）；其後他應穿上其衣著，應回返其住處。

segments.orig:
airime gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta añtare
aredhem nmânahe pâreñtare haca anyaêibyô
mazdayasnaêibyô mâ xshayamna jasôit âtrem
mâ âpem mâ zãm mâ gãm mâ
urvarãm mâ narem ashavanem mâ nâirikãm
ashaonîm vîspem â ahmât ýat hê
thrâyô xshafna sacåñte, âat pasca
thrixshaparât us tanûm snayaêta us vastrât
gêush maêsmana apâca paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
'He shall sit down there in the place of infirmity, inside
the house, apart from the other worshippers of Mazda. He shall
not go near the fire, nor near the water, nor near the earth,
nor near the cow, nor near the trees, nor near the faithful, either
man or woman. Thus shall he continue until three nights have passed.
When three nights have passed, he shall wash his body, he shall
wash his clothes with gomez and water to make them clean.
segments.zh: 『他應在那裡坐下，在病弱之所，在住處內側，遠離馬茲達的其他信仰者。他應不接近火焰，亦不接近水，亦不接近大地，亦不接近牛隻，亦不接近樹木，亦不接近信徒，無論男性或女性。他應如是繼續直到三個夜晚已經過去。當三個夜晚已經過去，他應洗淨其身體，他應以牛尿與水洗淨其衣著以使其潔淨。

segments.orig:
airime gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta añtare
aredhem nmânahe pâreñtare haca anyaêibyô
mazdayasnaêibyô mâ xshayamna jasôit âtrem
mâ âpem mâ zãm ... ýat hê
xshvash xshafna sacåñte, âat pasca xshvash-xshaparât
us tanûm snayaêta us vastrât gêush maêsmana
apâca paiti avatha ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
'Then he shall sit down again in the place of infirmity, inside
the house, apart from the other worshippers of Mazda. He shall
not go near the fire, nor near the water, nor near the earth,
nor near the cow, nor near the trees, nor near the faithful, either
man or woman. Thus shall he continue until six nights have passed.
When six nights have passed, he shall wash his body, he shall
wash his clothes with gomez and water to make them clean.
segments.zh: 『其後他應再次在那裡坐下，在病弱之所，在住處內側，遠離馬茲達的其他信仰者。他應不接近火焰，亦不接近水，亦不接近大地，亦不接近牛隻，亦不接近樹木，亦不接近信徒，無論男性或女性。他應如是繼續直到六個夜晚已經過去。當六個夜晚已經過去，他應洗淨其身體，他應以牛尿與水洗淨其衣著以使其潔淨。

segments.orig:
airime gâtûm hê nishhidhaêta añtare
... ýat hê nava xshafna sacåñte, âat
pasca nava-xshaparât us tanûm snayaêta us ...
ýaozhdayãn.
segments.en:
'Then he shall sit down again in the place of infirmity, inside
the house, apart from the other worshippers of Mazda. He shall
not go near the fire, nor near the water, nor near the earth,
nor near the cow, nor near the trees, nor near the faithful, either
man or woman. Thus shall he continue, until nine nights have passed.
When nine nights have passed, he shall wash his body, he shall
wash his clothes with gomez and water to make them clean.
segments.zh: 『其後他應再次在那裡坐下，在病弱之所，在住處內側，遠離馬茲達的其他信仰者。他應不接近火焰，亦不接近水，亦不接近大地，亦不接近牛隻，亦不接近樹木，亦不接近信徒，無論男性或女性。他應如是繼續，直到九個夜晚已經過去。當九個夜晚已經過去，他應洗淨其身體，他應以牛尿與水洗淨其衣著以使其潔淨。

segments.orig:
pascaêta xshayamna jasôit avi âtrem avi
âpem avi zãm avi gãm avi urvarãm avi
narem ashavanem avi nâirikãm ashaonîm!
segments.en:
'He may thenceforth go near the fire, near the water, near
the earth, near the cow, near the trees, and near the faithful,
either man or woman.
segments.zh: 『其後他可以接近火焰，接近水，接近大地，接近牛隻，接近樹木，以及接近信徒，無論男性或女性。

segments.orig:
âthravanem ýaozhdathô dahmayât parô
âfritôit dainghêush dainghu-paitîm ýaozhdathô
ushtrahe paiti arshnô akhryehe zañtêush zañtu-paitîm
ýaozhdathô aspahe paiti arshnô akhryehe vîsô
vîspaitîm ýaozhdathô gêush paiti
uxshnô akhryehe nmânahe nmânô-paitîm
ýaozhdathô gêush paiti azyå.
segments.en:
'Thou shalt cleanse a priest for a blessing of the just.
'Thou shalt cleanse the lord of a province for the value of a
camel of high value.
'Thou shalt cleanse the lord of a town for the value of a stallion
of high value.
'Thou shalt cleanse the lord of a borough for the value of a bull
of high value.
'Thou shalt cleanse the master of a house for the value of a cow
three years old.
segments.zh:
你應為得福的正義者淨禮一位祭司。
你應為一個行省之主淨禮，代價為一頭高等價值的駱駝。
你應為一個城鎮之主淨禮，代價為一匹高等價值的公馬。
你應為一個行政區之主淨禮，代價為一頭高等價值的公牛。
你應為一個家的主人淨禮，代價為一頭三歲的母牛。

segments.orig:
nmânahe nmânô-paitîm nâirikãm
ýaozhdathô gêush paiti fravaityå vaêsêsca
pairyaêtrêshca ýaozhdathô gêush
paiti vazyå nitememcit aperenâyûkem ýaozhdathô
pasêush garebush anumayehe.
segments.en:
'Thou shalt cleanse the wife of the master of a house for
the value of a ploughing cow.
'Thou shalt cleanse a menial for the value of a draught cow.
'Thou shalt cleanse a young child for the value of a lamb.
segments.zh:
你應為一個家的主人之妻淨禮，代價為一頭耕作母牛。
你應為一個下人淨禮，代價為一頭駄馬母牛。
你應為一個幼童淨禮，代價為一隻羔羊。

segments.orig:
ýezi tavãn aête mazdayasna aête
pasvô staorâca aêtahmâi naire frabârayen,
ýezi nôit tavãn aête mazdayasna aête
pasvô staorâca anyãm hê avaretãm
aêtahmâi naire frabârayen vîspem â
ahmât ýat aêshô nâ ýô
ýaozhdâthryô haca aêibyô nmânaêibyô
xshnûtô adhbishtô pârayât.
segments.en:
'These are the heads of cattle -- flocks or herds -- that the
worshippers of Mazda shall give to the man who has cleansed them,
if they can afford it; if they cannot afford it, they shall give
him any other value that may make him leave their houses well
pleased with them, and free from anger.
segments.zh: 這些是牲畜——羊群或牧群——馬茲達的崇拜者應給予為他們淨禮的人的頭數，如果他們負擔得起；如果他們負擔不起，他們應給予他任何其他代價，足以讓他帶著滿意而非怒火離開他們的家。

segments.orig:
ýezica aêshô nâ ýô ýaozhdâthryô
haca aêibyô nmânaêibyô tbishtô
axshnûtô parâiti apa hê paskât fraoirisaite
spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush
nånghanat haca cashmanat haca hizumat haca paitishhvarenâdha
fravâxshat haca frashumakat haca tê,
segments.en:
'For if the man who has cleansed them leave their houses displeased
with them, and full of anger, then the Druj Nasu enters them from
the nose [of the dead], from the eyes, from the tongue, from the
jaws, from the sexual organs, from the hinder parts.
segments.zh: 「若清淨彼等者不悅於彼等而滿心怒火而離其舍，則德魯格‧納蘇從死者之鼻、眼、舌、頜、性器官、臀部而入彼等。

segments.orig:
aêshãm paiti sraoe aêsha druxsh ýâ
nasush upa-dvãsaiti ayaozhdya pascaêta bavaiñti
ýavaêca ýavaêtâtaêca, anusô
zî spitama zarathushtra aêsha ýâ paiti-
irista avat hvare â-tâpaite anusô hâu
må anusô ave stârô.
segments.en:
'And the Druj Nasu rushes upon them even to the end of the
nails, and they are unclean thenceforth for ever and ever.
'It grieves the sun indeed, O Spitama Zarathushtra! to shine upon
a man defiled by the dead; it grieves the moon, it grieves the
stars.
segments.zh:
「德魯格‧納蘇撲向彼等，甚至指甲之端，自此永永遠遠彼等皆成不潔。
「日輪為之悲傷，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！而照耀被死者污穢之人；月輪為之悲傷，星辰為之悲傷。

segments.orig:
xshnâvayeiti zî spitama zarathushtra aêshô
nâ ýô ýaozhdâthryô ýat
aêtem paiti-iristem frâ-nasûm kerenaoiti xshnâvayeiti
âtrem xshnâvayeiti âpem xshnâvayeiti zãm
xshnâvayeiti gãm xshnâvayeiti urvarãm
xshnâvayeiti narem ashavanem xshnâvayeiti nâirikãm
ashaonîm!
segments.en:
'That man delights them, O Spitama Zarathushtra! who cleanses
from the Nasu the man defiled by the dead; he delights the fire,
he delights the water, he delights the earth, he delights the
cow, he delights the trees, he delights the faithful, both men
and women.'
segments.zh: 那個人使他們歡喜啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！他從納蘇中淨禮被死者污染的人；他使火歡喜，他使水歡喜，他使土歡喜，他使牛歡喜，他使樹木歡喜，他使信仰者歡喜，男人和女人。

segments.orig:
paiti dim peresata zarathushtrô, dâtare gaêthanãm
astvaitinãm ashâum cvat ahmâi naire mizhdem
anghat pasca astasca baodhanghasca vî-urvîshtîm
ýat aêtem paiti-iristem frâ-nasûm kerenaoiti.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Maker of the material world,
thou Holy One! What shall be his reward, after his soul has parted
from his body, who has cleansed from the Nasu the man defiled
by the dead?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那從納蘇中淨禮被死者污染的人，在他的靈魂離開他的身體之後，他的報酬將是什麼？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, disyât ahmâi
naire avat mizhdem parô-asnâi anguhe vazdvare vahishtahe
anghêush.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The welfare of Paradise thou canst
promise to that man, for his reward in the other world.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「天堂的福祉你可以應許給那個人，作為他在來世的報酬。」

segments.orig:
paiti dim peresata zarathushtrô, dâtare ... ashâum
kutha aêtat druxsh perenâne ýâ haca irista
upa jvañtem upa-dvãsaiti kutha aêtat nasu
perenâne ýâ haca irista upa jvañtem
upa-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Maker of the material world,
thou Holy One! How shall I fight against that Druj who from the
dead rushes upon the living? How shall I fight against that Nasu
who from the dead defiles the living?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！我應如何對抗那從死者身上撲向活人的德魯格？我應如何對抗那從死者身上玷污活人的納蘇？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ime vaca framrva
ýôi heñti gâthâhva bishâmrûta
ime vaca framrva ýôi heñti gâthâhva
thrishâmrûta ime vâca framrva ýôi
heñti gâthâhva cathrushâmrûta,
mãnayen bâ spitama zarathushtra aipi tâ nasush
zgathaite ýatha ishush hvâthaxtô ýatha
vâ nematô tarô ýâre ýatha
vâ rathwya varena.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Say aloud those words in the Gathas
that are to be said twice.
'Say aloud those words in the Gathas that are to be said thrice.
'Say aloud those words in the Gathas that are to be said four
times.
'And the Druj shall fly away like the well-darted arrow, like
the felt of last year, like the annual garment of the earth.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「大聲誦讀那些應在迦薩中誦讀兩次的言辭。大聲誦讀那些應在迦薩中誦讀三次的言辭。大聲誦讀那些應在迦薩中誦讀四次的言辭。德魯格將如射出的利箭般飛走，如去年的氈毛般飛走，如大地的歲衣般飛走。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýezica hô nâ paiti- hiñcôit
ýô nôit apivatâite daênayå
mâzdayasnôish ýaozhdâthryât haca
kutha aêtat druxsh perenâite ýâ haca
irista upa jvañtem upa-dvãsaiti kutha aêtat
nasu perenâite ýâ haca irista upa jvañtem
upa-raêthwayeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man who
does not know the rites of cleansing according to the law of Mazda,
offers to cleanse the unclean, how shall I then fight against
that Druj who from the dead rushes upon the living? How shall
I fight against that Druj who from the dead defiles the living?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！倘若一個不知根據馬茲達律法進行淨禮儀式之人，要去淨化不潔者，我應如何對抗那從死者身上撲向活人的德魯格？我應如何對抗那從死者身上玷污活人的德魯格？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, mãnayen bâ
spitama zarathushtra aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush
ash-aojastara varedhayete ýatha para ahmât as, hâ
aête ýaska hâ aête mahrka hâ aête
paityâra hamatha ýatha paracit.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered : 'Then, O Spitama Zarathushtra! the
Druj Nasu appears to wax stronger than she was before. Stronger
then are sickness and death and the working of the fiend than
they were before.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「爾時，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！德魯格‧納蘇顯現為比從前更強盛。爾時疾病與死亡及妖魔之所為比從前更強盛。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, hañdarezacit hañdarezayen
aête ýôi mazdayasna zasta hê paoirîm
hañdarezayañta apa hê vastrå barayen
pãstô-frathanghem hê kameredhem vînâthayen
ash-hvaretemaêibyô speñtô- mainyavanãm
dâmanãm kerefsh-hvârãm kerefsh paiti-nisirinuyât
vayãm kahrkâsãm uityaojanô, avå
hîm paiti-mithnâiti vîspem dushmatemca duzhûxtemca
duzhvarshtemca.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What is the
penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The worshippers of Mazda shall bind him;
they shall bind his hands first; then they shall strip him of
his clothes, they shall cut the head off his neck, and they shall
give over his corpse unto the greediest of the corpse-eating creatures
made by the beneficent Spirit, unto the vultures, with these words:
-
'"The man here has repented of all his evil thoughts, words,
and deeds.
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！他應付什麼罰？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬茲達的信徒應將他綁縛；他們應先綁他的雙手；然後他們應剝去他的衣裳，他們應砍下他的頸項之頭，他們應將他的屍體交予善靈所造最貪食納蘇的生物，交予禿鷹，以這些言辭：『此人已對其一切惡念、惡言與惡行悔悟。

segments.orig:
ýezica hê anya akha shyaothna fravarshta patita
hê citha, âat ýezi-shê anya akha shyaothna
nôit fravarshta patitem ahe narsh ýavaêca ýavaêtâtaêca!
segments.en:
'"If he has committed any other evil deed, it is remitted
by his repentance; if he has committed no other evil deed, he
is absolved by his repentance for ever and ever."'
segments.zh: 若他曾犯其他任何惡行，則因其悔悟而獲赦免；若他未曾犯其他任何惡行，則因其悔悟而永遠永遠獲得赦免。』」

segments.orig:
cish hâu as ahura mazda ýô mê asadayat
fradathem apa-barat varedathem apa-barat ýaskem upa-barat
mahrkem upa-barat.
segments.en:
Who is he, O Ahura Mazda! who threatens to take away fullness
and increase from the world, and to bring in sickness and death?
segments.zh: 誰啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！威脅著要奪取世界的豐盈與增長，並帶來疾病與死亡？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hô bâ
aêshô âs ashâum zarathushtra ashemaokhô
anashava ýô aêtahmi anghvô ýat
astvaiñti paiti-hiñcaiti â-dim nôit
apivatâite daênayå mâzdayasnôish
ýaozhdâthryât haca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the ungodly Ashemaogha, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! who in this material world cleanses the unclean
without knowing the rites of cleansing according to the law of
Mazda.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！乃是不虔敬的埃什瑪歐格哈，在此物質世界中淨化不潔者，卻不知根據馬茲達律法進行淨禮儀式。

segments.orig:
para nû ahmât haca asanghatca shôithrâatca
axshtat spitama zarathushtra izhâca âzûitishca
para dasvareca baêshazemca para fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca para ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem.
segments.en:
'For until then, O Spitama Zarathushtra! sweetness and fatness
would flow out from that land and from those fields, with health
and healing, with fullness and increase and growth, and a growing
of corn and grass.'
segments.zh: 「直到那時，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！甘美與油脂將從那塊土地與那些田地流出，伴隨健康與治癒，伴隨充裕與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的增長。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kadha nô ahmâi asanghaêca
shôithraêca paiti-jasâtô izhâca
âzûitishca kadha dasvareca baêshazemca kadha
fradathemca varedathemca vaxshathemca kadha ýavanãmca
vâstranãmca uruthem.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When are sweetness
and fatness to come back again to that land and to those fields,
with health and healing, with fullness and increase and growth,
and a growing of corn and grass?
55, 56. Ahura Mazda answered: 'Sweetness and fatness will never come
back again to that land and to those fields, with health and healing,
with fullness and increase and growth, and a growing of corn and
grass, until that ungodly Ashemaogha has been smitten to death
on the spot, and the holy Sraosha of that place has been offered
up a sacrifice, for three days and three nights, with fire blazing,
with Baresma tied up, and with Haoma prepared.
segments.zh:
「物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！甘美與油脂何時將再次回歸到那塊土地與那些田地，伴隨健康與治癒，伴隨充裕與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的增長？」

「阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『直到那個不虔誠的埃什瑪歐格哈在現場被擊殺，以及該地的聖潔斯勞沙被獻祭，三日三夜，烈火熊熊，巴雷斯瑪束緊，豪麻已備好，甘美與油脂才將再次回歸到那塊土地與那些田地，伴隨健康與治癒，伴隨充裕與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的增長。」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit nû
para ahmât spitama zarathushtra asanghaêca shôithraêca
paiti-jasâtô izhâca âzûitishca nôit
dasvareca baêshazemca nôit fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca nôit ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem.

para ahmât ýat idha ashemaokhô anashava
hathra jatô nijanâite ýat vâ aêtanghå
dainghêush sraoshô ashyô frâyazåñte
thri-ayarem thri-xshaparem saociñtat paiti âthrat
frasteretât paiti baresmen uzdâtât paiti haomât.

pascaêta ahmâi asanghaêca shôithraêca
paiti-jasâtô izhâca âzûitishca pascaêta
dasvareca baêshazemca pascaêta fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca pascaêta ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'Then sweetness
and fatness will come back again to that land and to those fields,
with health and healing, with fullness and increase and growth,
and a growing of corn and grass.'
segments.zh: 「之後甘美與油脂將再次回歸到那塊土地與那些田地，伴隨健康與治癒，伴隨充裕與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的增長。」
